title: New nonconformance
purpose: Raise a nonconformance record for a problem found in the laboratory's work.
summary: Raise a record for a problem found in the laboratory's work. Every staff role can raise one; a supervisor can also choose its owner here.

tasks.title: Raise a nonconformance
steps: Choose the [[Source]] and [[Severity]], and add the [[Area or section]] if it helps.
Note any [[Containment]] already done and select [[Raise nonconformance]].

tasks.title: Choose the owner straight away (supervisors)
steps: Pick the person in [[Owner]], or leave No owner yet to choose later on the record.

good_to_know: Refer to an order, sample or ticket number such as ORD-TEST-000042. Do not enter patient names or identifiers: every staff role reads every record.
Only a supervisor sees Owner. A record raised without one has no owner until a supervisor chooses it, and until then only supervisors work it.
For a complaint, use Open nonconformance on the ticket instead. That links the ticket and sets the source to Complaint.
The record starts in Open and gets a number such as NC-000123.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: Every staff role can raise a nonconformance while the optional nonconformance module is on; otherwise this page answers Not found. It opens from New nonconformance on the Nonconformances and Corrective actions lists, as a dialog or a full page.

sections.title: Fields and actions
paragraphs: A No patient data notice heads the form: Refer to an order, sample or ticket number. Do not enter patient names or identifiers. Leading and trailing spaces are removed from text.

items.label: Title
items.description: Required, up to 160 characters. Shown in the lists and the record's heading.

items.label: What happened
items.description: Required, up to 4,000 characters. What was found, where and when.

items.label: Source
items.description: Required: Complaint, Found internally, Audit finding, Proficiency testing, Equipment, External assessment, Preventive action or improvement, or Other. Choosing Complaint here does not link a ticket.

items.label: Severity
items.description: Required: Minor, Major or Critical. The laboratory's own grading; its procedures say what each level means.

items.label: Area or section
items.description: Optional, up to 80 characters. Where in the laboratory it happened, in the laboratory's own terms. Searchable in the list.

items.label: Containment
items.description: Optional, up to 4,000 characters, under First steps. What was done at once to limit the problem. It can be completed later on the investigation form.

items.label: Owner
items.description: Supervisors only (the admin role included), optional, under First steps. The person who works the record; No owner yet leaves it to be chosen later. It must be an active staff account with a staff role, otherwise: Choose an active staff member as the owner.

items.label: Raise nonconformance
items.description: Creates the record in status Open, numbered NC- and six digits, confirms Nonconformance NC-000123 raised. and opens it. The raising is recorded in the record's history.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the Nonconformances list without raising anything.

items.label: Signed out by a time limit
items.description: When a time limit signs you out, what you typed here is kept for 24 hours, for you in that browser only, and comes back on this page when you sign in again there (the dialog opens again on its own page). The owner chosen comes back only while their account is still an active staff account, and only for a supervisor.
